facts.claim: 쑨원이 1919년 '중국의 국제 개발'에서 양쯔강 큰 댐을 구상
facts.note: Sun Yat-sen envisioned a large dam across the Yangtze River in The International Development of China (1919).

facts.claim: 1944년 미국 개척국 설계 기술자 존 L. 새비지가 조사해 댐 제안서
facts.note: In 1944, the United States Bureau of Reclamation's head design engineer, John L. Savage, surveyed the area and drew up a dam proposal for a "Yangtze River Project".

The National People's Congress approved the dam in 1992: of 2,633 delegates, 1,767 voted in favour, 177 voted against, 664 abstained, and 25 members did not vote, giving the legislation an unusually low 67.75% approval rate.
In 2005, NASA scientists calculated that the shift of water mass stored by the dams would increase the total length of the Earth's day by 0.06 microseconds

question.hintNote: Estimates of the number of people displaced by the dam's construction range from 1.13 million to around 1.4 million.
